description: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'PartialJobSpecificationAttachment' used for encapsulating attachment data related to job specifications in the HRM system. Contains properties for id, filename, file type, size, and associated job title id, with constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: PartialJobSpecificationAttachment
classes.description: A DTO class for representing an attachment to a partial job specification, including properties like id, filename, type, size, and associated job title id.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the DTO with provided attachment details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type/mime type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the associated job title ID.
